description:
Ohio State at Indiana
The No. 5 Indiana Hoosiers host the No. 4 Ohio State Buckeyes for a top-five Big Ten conference showdown at Memorial Stadium. Indiana sits in first place in Big Ten with Josh Hoover leading the team, while Julian Sayin leads third place Ohio State.
